targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-978 (2026-09-03) NON-CONTRIBUTORY for both tagged claims (recorded direction was `mixed`). The run is the owed validation of the SD-018 directional-field amend and does not exercise MECH-457's actor-critic substrate or INV-088's evaluator/z_world relation; both tags are downstream-beneficiary tags from SD-018's unblocks_claims. THE SUBSTANTIVE RESULT, which belongs on SD-018 rather than on either claim: the directional auxiliary loss was applied and demonstrably trained (used_resource_field_head 3/3, weight 0.5, P0a held-out field r2 0.678/0.627/0.653) and z_world did NOT move -- delta sense-path decode r2 -0.00063, delta encoder-path r2 +0.00038, delta participation-ratio +0.0029, all two to three orders below the within-arm seed spread (~0.099 r2, ~1.61 PR) and sign-inconsistent across seeds. C_on_clears_floor (load-bearing) failed 0/3 seeds (0.30/0.30/0.25 vs a 1.0 floor); C_off_subfloor_replication passed; C_decode_lift failed on margin only (-0.00063 vs +0.05) while its absolute conjunct r_on > 0 passed at 0.7093. CRITICAL ROUTING FINDING: the driver's own pre-registered null table says to read the OFF arm's ABSOLUTE r2 first -- if OFF already decodes well, the null points at the CONSUMER (shape b); only if BOTH arms decode poorly is the result a statement about the P0a training recipe. Measured OFF r2 is 0.710 sense-path and 0.858 encoder-path: both arms decode the resource field WELL. By the author's own conditional this is shape (b) -- i.e. NOT the P0a training recipe. IMPORTANT LIMIT ON THAT INFERENCE: 'not the encoder recipe' is not the same as 'the consumer'. A linear probe recovering the field at r2 0.71-0.86 shows the information is PRESENT; it does not show it is in a geometry a policy can use under the actual learning dynamics. This run therefore does NOT separate a consumer/readout learning failure from a representational mismatch, and any routing that presupposes one of the two is running ahead of the evidence. The emitted label nonetheless reads `Re-run at another weight before concluding`, because the code's label ladder never consults r_off -- the label contradicts the driver's own pre-registration and must not drive the routing. SD-018's implementation_log[0] already names the correct next step: 'Shape (b) (raw field as side-channel past z_world) is the fallback if (a) nulls.' Corroborating and NOT in the manifest: in the fishtank log the ON-arm head's argmax varies across 17 of 25 cells on the encoder path (9.28% match to truth vs 4.0% uniform / 23.71% majority-cell) but is constant at cell 6 across all 97 sense-time steps, with the OFF arm constant on both paths -- the red-team F7 signature the author said would route a null to shape (b) rather than back to the P0a recipe (seed 42 only, unequal samples). HYPOTHESIS-SPACE READING (added after reading the user's own 2026-09-03 thought documents, which were written against this run): docs/thoughts/2026-09-03_temporary_coordinated_representational_transformations.md enumerates three readings this run leaves open -- A information loss (WEAKENED by the OFF-arm decode), B consumer/readout/learning failure, C representational mismatch (information recoverable, geometry not accessible to the decision computation) -- and states at section 8, verbatim, that 'V3-EXQ-978 does not distinguish B from C.' That is the live question, and the document records that B 'should be tested before introducing richer architecture.'

learning_extracted: z_world ALREADY encodes the resource field to a linear probe (OFF-arm decode r2 0.710 sense / 0.858 encoder). Read together with V3-EXQ-948's behavioural finding, the distinction that survives is decodable-versus-USABLE: the information is present and competent behaviour does not follow. That refines the stated project front -- the binding constraint at this node is NOT the encoder -- but it does not localise the constraint to the consumer, because decodability by a probe and usability by a policy are different properties.

A driver can carry a correct pre-registered conditional in its docstring and a label ladder in its code that never evaluates that conditional. Here the docstring routes to shape (b) and the label says 're-run at another weight'. The label is what a downstream reader sees.

The manipulation was a ~1.5x REWEIGHTING, not supervision-vs-none: reconstruction_weight 10.0 already supervises the field at 10/250 per element and the ON leg adds 0.5/25. A null under a 1.5x reweighting is weak evidence about supervision in general, which is exactly why the absolute OFF-arm r2 is the load-bearing read.
Both trained arms scoring below the random-walk anchor (0.25-0.55 vs 0.85-1.05) is itself a finding about the bed, independent of the arm contrast.

live_hypotheses: H-B consumer/readout/learning failure: the information in z_world is in an adequately usable form and the downstream consumer has simply failed to learn the mapping from representation to action.

H-C representational mismatch: the information is technically recoverable but the current geometry does not make the relationships required by action selection accessible under the actual learning dynamics.

suggested_probes.sketch: Frozen-latent SUPERVISED oracle adapter. Freeze z_world exactly as this run left it and behaviour-clone the local_view_greedy oracle policy (which scores 45.75 on this same field) from the frozen latent. Declared null: the adapter cannot reproduce oracle actions above the pre-registered floor. CANNOT reproduce -> H-C (geometry unusable, the information is there and a simple supervised reader cannot exploit it). CAN reproduce -> H-B (the representation is usable and the deficit is in the RL consumer's learning, not the geometry). This is the user's own 'Experiment 1' from the 2026-09-03 thought document.

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1. The load-bearing point is WHY this is not a single build. SD-018's pre-declared fallback -- shape (b), routing the raw resource field as a side-channel PAST z_world -- PRESUPPOSES H-B: it is only the right build if the representation, not its usability, is the problem. If H-C holds, shape (b) may well raise the score while telling us nothing about the actual constraint, and would bank a confident-but-wrong localisation. The supervised adapter is strictly cheaper than shape (b) (no substrate change at all, one frozen-latent training run) and, unlike it, DISCRIMINATES. Note that the frozen-latent reader has already been run TWICE with a PPO reader and failed both times (V3-EXQ-948 ppo_ree_latent 0.5, V3-EXQ-978 OFF 0.267, both 0/3 against floor) -- but PPO is an RL learner, so those failures are confounded with RL credit-assignment difficulty. A SUPERVISED behaviour-clone removes exactly that confound, which is what makes it the discriminator rather than a third repetition.

claim_rotation_observation.verdict: YES on all three counts, for this one case. The rotated framing produced a next experiment that is SMALLER (a single frozen-latent supervised training run versus a substrate build plus its own validation), CHEAPER (no ree_core change, so no contract-gate exposure), and MORE DISCRIMINATING (the build presupposes the answer to the live question; the probe settles it). It also converted the node from `complicated (buildable)` to `complex (probe-gated)`, which is the direction CLAUDE.md's debt vocabulary says to prefer.
claim_rotation_observation.caveat: N=1, and it is not blind: the same thought document supplied both the rotation and the probe, so this trial cannot separate 'rotation helps' from 'this author's next idea was good'. Recorded as one held-out data point, not as support for the general rule.
